examples.sentence: 女儿个子跟我差不多一样高。
examples.romanization: nǚ'ér gèzi gēn wǒ chàbuduō yīyàng gāo。
examples.translation: My daughter is about as tall as me.
The loss and the gain are almost the same.

examples.sentence: 这件事我几乎忘了告诉你了。
examples.romanization: zhè jiàn shì wǒ jīhū wàng le gàosu nǐ le。
examples.translation: I almost forgot to tell you about this.

examples.sentence: 尽管今天很冷，可是他穿的衣服很少。
examples.romanization: jǐnguǎn jīntiān hěn lěng， kěshì tā chuān de yīfu hěn shǎo。
examples.translation: Although it is very cold today, he wears very little clothes.

examples.sentence: (虽然/尽管) 工作很忙，她们却每天坚持锻炼。
examples.romanization: ( suīrán/ jǐnguǎn) gōngzuò hěn máng， tāmen què měitiān jiānchí duànliàn。
examples.translation: (Although) they are busy at work, but they insist on exercising every day.

examples.sentence: 听、说能力很重要，而写汉字的能力也重要。
examples.romanization: tīng、 shuō nénglì hěn zhòngyào， ér xiě hànzì de nénglì yě zhòngyào。
examples.translation: Listening and speaking abilities are very important, and (on the other hand) the ability to write Chinese characters is also important.

title: 挺 A 的 (quite A)
longExplanation: quite A. Pinyin: tǐng A de

examples.romanization: wǒ tǐng xǐhuan zhège dìfang de。

examples.sentence: 她本来想学新闻，但是现在学习法律。
examples.romanization: tā běnlái xiǎng xué xīnwén， dànshì xiànzài xuéxí fǎlǜ。
examples.translation: She originally wanted to learn the news, but now she is studying law.

title: 本来就 V/A (V/A in the first place)
longExplanation: V/A in the first place. Pinyin: běnlái jiù V/A

examples.sentence: 学生本来就不应该上课迟到。
examples.romanization: xuésheng běnlái jiù bù yīnggāi shàngkè chídào。
examples.translation: Students should not be late for class in the first place.

title: 另/另外/另外的 + # + N (another # N)
longExplanation: another # N. Pinyin: lìng/ lìngwài/ lìngwài de + # + N

examples.sentence: 他拿出另/另外/另外的一本书。
examples.romanization: tā náchū lìng/ lìngwài/ lìngwài de yī běn shū。

pattern: 另外的/其他的/别的 N
title: 另外的/其他的/别的 N (other N)
longExplanation: other N. Pinyin: lìngwài de/ qítā de/ biéde N
formation: lìngwài de/ qítā de/ biéde N

examples.sentence: 不要看这本书，请看另外的/其他的/别的书。
examples.romanization: bùyào kàn zhè běn shū， qǐngkàn lìngwài de/ qítā de/ biéde shū。
examples.translation: Don't read this book, please read other books.

title: 另/另外 V (V another)
longExplanation: V another. Pinyin: lìng/ lìngwài V

examples.sentence: 他另/另外给了我三十元。
examples.romanization: tā lìng/ lìngwài gěi le wǒ sānshí yuán。

examples.sentence: 多吃水果。另外，还要记得多喝水。
examples.romanization: duō chī shuǐguǒ。 lìngwài， hái yào jìde duō hē shuǐ。
examples.translation: Eat more fruits. Also, remember to drink more water.
